test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the scheme that the Government of India announced in Budget 2019, which will provide a guaranteed income of Rs. 6,000 per year to small and marginal farmers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The government of India's Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi **programme provides all farmers with **basic income support of up to 6,000 rupees per year**.
 
• **Piyush Goyal** announced the plan at India's 2019 Interim Union Budget on February 1, 2019.
 
• The plan, which costs 75,000 crores per year, went into operation in December 2018.
 
• Each qualifying farmer will get $6,000 per year in three instalments, sent straight into their bank accounts. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana** on February 18, 2016, as a yield insurance programme for farmers. 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojan**a is a national initiative aimed at increasing farm output and better utilising the country's resources. This scheme has been given a budget of 53 billion dollars for the 2015-2016 fiscal year.
 
• **The "Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojna (PKVY)," **a sub-component of the National Mission of Sustainable Agriculture's (NMSA) Soil Health Management(SHM) scheme, aims to develop sustainable organic farming models using a mix of traditional wisdom and modern science to ensure long-term soil fertility, resource conservation, and climate change adaptation and mitigation.
